summary: Frontend-only retest of Toko HP scan barcode fix. Logged in as admin@tokohp.com. Verified the fix: /produk now shows crud-scan-btn next to search bar, and clicking it opens the barcode-reader dialog without crashes; Produk table remains intact after closing. Regression of the other 4 scan entry points also passed: kasir-scan-btn (/kasir), scan-sku & scan-imei (Produk Tambah modal), and purchase-scan-btn (Pembelian Baru modal) — all open the barcode-reader dialog cleanly. No page errors, no console errors. No writes were made to production Atlas.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 gap (missing crud-scan-btn on /produk) is fully resolved. Products.jsx now passes scanSearch to CrudResource which renders data-testid=crud-scan-btn. Pembelian button label is 'Pembelian Baru' (not 'Tambah'); use that when locating the button in future tests.
